data_notes: Where both existed (to 2022), VWH matched the QC'd spectral Hs (VCAR) to within about 0.1 m RMS.
caveats_extra: C46206 sits on the outer shelf. Conditions at the work site, especially further offshore, may differ.

data_notes: The sharp rise on 29 Oct 2025 (7.0 to 10.2 m in one hour) was followed 2–3 h later by a 9.1 m peak at La Perouse Bank, consistent with a real storm.
key_results_extra: May is noticeably rougher here than at La Perouse Bank.
caveats_extra: C46132 sits off the Brooks Peninsula, further north and more exposed than La Perouse Bank. Conditions at the work site may differ from either buoy.

stations.name: South Nomad
stations.summary: Open-ocean buoy about 590 km west of La Perouse Bank; not included by default.
notes: Sea-state changes usually reach it first, so it gives early warning of weather arriving at the coast.

data_notes: The MEDS QC'd value (VCAR) in this record is a 10,000 m placeholder throughout (January–August 2024) and is removed, so the buoy-reported value (VWH) is used for the whole period.
key_results_extra: Changes in sea state usually reach South Nomad before the coastal buoys, consistent with swell and storms arriving from offshore.
caveats_extra: C46036 is far offshore in the open Pacific. It represents incoming deep-water sea state, not conditions on the shelf or at the NEPTUNE sites, which are generally lower.
